Datu Montawal''' ([[Maguindanao language|Maguindanaon]]: ''Ingud nu Datu Montawal''; [[Iranun language|Iranun]]: ''Inged a Datu Montawal''; {{langx|tl|Bayan ng Datu Montawal}}), is a [[municipality of the Philippines|municipality]] in the [[Philippine Province|province]] of [[Maguindanao del Sur]], [[Philippines]]. According to the {{PH wikidata|population_as_of}}, it has a population of {{PH wikidata|population_total}} people.{{PH wikidata|population_reference}} The municipality, then known as '''Pagagawan''', was created under ''Muslim Mindanao Autonomy Act No. 95'' on July 18, 2000, carved out of the municipality of [[Pagalungan]].{{cite web|title=Muslim Mindanao Autonomy Act No. 95; An Act Creating the Municipality of Pagagawan in the Province of Maguindanao, and for Other Purposes|url=http://rla-armmgov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/MMAA-95.pdf|website=Regional Legislative Assembly, Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao|accessdate=January 27, 2016}} It was renamed to ''Datu Montawal'' under ''Muslim Mindanao Autonomy Act No. 152'' on June 9, 2003.{{cite web|title=Muslim Mindanao Autonomy Act No. 152; An Act Changing the Name of Pagagawan in the Province of Maguindanao to Municipality of Datu Montawal|url=http://rla-armmgov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/MMAA-152.pdf|website=Regional Legislative Assembly, Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao|accessdate=January 27, 2016}}{{cite web|title=Datu Montawal Profile |url=https://maguindanao.gov.ph/images/municipalities/2nddistrict/DATU_MONTAWAL.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220622135331/https://maguindanao.gov.ph/images/municipalities/2nddistrict/DATU_MONTAWAL.pdf |archive-date=June 22, 2022 |website=Provincial Government of Maguindanao|accessdate=August 27, 2022}} It should be noted, however, that: ''The change of name of any local government unit shall be effective only upon ratification in a plebiscite conducted for the purpose in the political unit directly affected.''{{Cite web |date=October 10, 1991 |title=Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991) |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1991/10/10/republic-act-no-7160/ |url-status=live |access-date=August 6, 2026 |website=Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines}} As no plebiscite for the name change from '''Pagagawan''' to '''Datu Montawal''' took place, the name change is unofficial and without legal basis, since a ''Muslim Mindanao Autonomy Act'' cannot override national law. The municipality should continue to be referred to by its legal name, '''Pagagawan'''. ==Geography== ===Barangays=== {{stack|float=right|[[File:Municipal Hall of Datu Montawal, Maguindanao del Sur.jpg|320px|thumb|right|Municipal Hall of Datu Montawal]]}} Datu Montawal is politically subdivided into 11 [[barangay]]s. Each barangay consists of [[purok]]s while some have [[sitios]]. *Balatungkayo (''Batungkayo'') *Bulit *Bulod *Dungguan *Limbalud *Maridagao *Nabundas *Pagagawan *Talapas *Talitay *Tunggol
